title: 2026-00143 PO Date Change for Case-Tech Conference.pdf
text:
STATE OF MAINE 
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 

Docket No. 2026-00143 

July 9, 2026 

CENTRAL MAINE POWER COMPANY 
Request for Approval Regarding Hartland Solar 
Interconnection Project Pursuant to 
35-A M.R.S. § 3132-A 

PROCEDURAL ORDER 

On June 15, 2026, the Presiding Officers in this matter issued a Notice of 
Proceeding which, among other things, set a date for an initial case conference and 
technical conference for Tuesday, July 28, 2026. Due to a scheduling conflict, the 
Presiding Officers must reschedule the initial case conference and technical 
conference. In light of the conflict, the initial case conference and technical conference 
is rescheduled for Thursday, July 30, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. The initial case conference 
and technical conference will be conducted in the Simpson Room of the Commission 
Offices at 26 Katherine Drive, Hallowell, Maine. Parties wishing to participate in the 
conference remotely or telephonically may do so by contacting Dale Coty 
(dale.coty@maine.gov) for an Outlook invitation containing the Microsoft Teams link or 
call-in number. 

All other portions of the Notice of Proceeding remain in full force and effect. 

Dated at Hallowell, Maine, this 9th day of July 2026. 

BY ORDER OF THE PRESIDING OFFICERS 

___/s/ Daya Taylor___ 
Daya Taylor 

_/s/ Rebecca McMahon_ 
Rebecca McMahon 

Presiding Officers
case_title: CENTRAL MAINE POWER COMPANY REQUEST FOR APPROVAL OF HARTLAND SOLAR INTERCONNECTION PROJECT PURSUANT TO 35-A M.R.S.A. 3132-A
